description: Declarative, reviewed additions to the supplied rule files. The source rule JSON is never modified; every entry here is shown next to the affected rule in the API and UI. Entries are data, not code.

EMIR-1.rationale: The rule description reads 'All derivatives must include a non-null Underlying_ISIN'. The supplied logic places the Derivative test inside an AND, which on its own would mark every Equity, Bond, FX and Commodity trade as non-compliant. Applicability is declared explicitly; for derivatives the original logic is evaluated unchanged.
